{"rules": ["Model exhibits severe underestimation bias when historical volatility is high (e.g., price swings >5%); forecasts are consistently ~10-15 EUR below true outcomes during this period.", "Forecasts show extreme lag in capturing sudden spikes; model predicts gradual linear growth while true outcomes exhibit sharp, non-linear jumps followed by rapid mean reversion.", "Sentiment history of 0.00 provides no predictive correction value; the model fails to adjust forecasts based on sentiment signals despite their presence.", "Model assumes a smooth upward trend (approx +0.15 EUR/day) whereas actual market dynamics are characterized by high-frequency oscillations and sudden reversals.", "Correction heuristic: Apply a volatility multiplier to forecast variance and reduce the mean trajectory by 12-18% when recent history shows price ranges exceeding 10 EUR."]
